Login: none inside Diri. Claude Code and Codex use their own CLI logins in the ademark account (not checked; ~/.claude and ~/.codex exist in the owner's account, contents not read), so login.kind is agent-cli. The profile does not touch accounts.json.

Telemetry: DIRI_TELEMETRY=off stops recording (diri-telemetry lib.rs), but a profile cannot set environment variables. The profile sets telemetry/config.json upload to false; whether that stops every upload path was not verified, and recording stays local.
Auto-update: prefs.json automaticUpdates false (prefs.rs). What's-new: whatsNewSeenVersion is set to 0.10.0 because a missing field reads as empty and would show the highlights once.

Processes: the engine dirijord-rs runs from the bundle (Contents/Resources/bin, daemon_launch.rs) and survives quit by design, so waitForPid by bundle path can attach to it after a normal quit. Holders are launchd jobs with label prefix com.dirijor.diri.holders. (holder/launcher.rs); reset() can only bootout exact labels. The wake helper is a system LaunchDaemon (com.dirijor.diri.wake, earlier pass). No Dirijor launch daemon or agent exists on this Mac (checked by name), and diri.ts notes that the helper needs admin approval.

Data: prefs.json lives in ~/Library/Application Support/diri, not in Dirijor (diri-proto paths.rs prefs_file). The adapter dataDirs in diri.ts lists only Dirijor, so the profile adds the diri folder and the caches. The owner's Mac has no Diri data folder yet.

Shortcuts: cmd+t runs new-default (commands.rs), which starts the default agent; cmd+1 and cmd+2 run select-session-1 and select-session-2 (commands.rs). Custom ordering keeps the order stable when a session is opened (prefs sidebarOrdering). Whether a new session is appended or prepended is unverified.

BLOCKED on 0.11.2, harness side (not fixable in this profile): Diri now reads letters from the key code and ignores the event's Unicode string. ademark-native types every character as virtual key 0 (kVK_ANSI_A) with a Unicode string (KeyPoster.typeText), so 'ademarkqz' arrives as 'aaaaaaaaa' in Claude Code and in a plain zsh tab alike (checked live with `ademark-native keys --text`; terminalOptionAsMeta off does not change it). A3, A4 and every echo/typing probe therefore never see the probe (gate 2026-11-07T08:58Z: A3 'new thread did not appear in 30 s', A4 timed_out, the A3 video shows a prompt full of 'a'). Paste (cmd+v) and key combos (cmd+t, ctrl+m, cmd+1) work.

BLOCKED on 0.11.2, harness side: session processes are fully disowned. diri-holder starts each session's /bin/zsh with ppid 1 and its own responsible pid, and claude runs under that zsh (checked with ademark-native procs), so neither the parent chain nor responsible_pid links them to the app, the engine or the holder.
